findings.title: Browser gate still expects ordinary Tab to leave the editor

requirement.quote: 保留编辑内容/元数据、安全链接和图片、格式化与撤销重做、列表/Tab、分栏预览、dirty/保存锁/丢弃、IME/选区/焦点和嵌套弹窗快捷键归属。
requirement.clarification: Tab inserts two spaces or indents blocks; Shift+Tab unindents; Escape prepares native Tab navigation.

source.quote: await textarea.press('Tab'); assert.equal(await textarea.evaluate((element) => document.activeElement === element), false);
Escape sets releaseTab.current=true; ordinary Tab calls preventDefault and apply(... + '  ' + ...).
Original native-navigation assertions preserved after explicit Escape; new collapsed Tab test expects a  b, defaultPrevented true and textarea focus.

findings.impact: The required native Markdown browser check retains its obsolete pre-Tab editing expectation and cannot validate the specified restored keyboard semantics; its failed assertion also prevents following Emoji/syntax/scroll checks in that check callback.
findings.recommendation: In a separately authorized candidate, preserve original navigation assertions by supplying Escape before native-navigation Tab, and add direct two-space/block/Shift+Tab checks. Do not change the frozen gate or run it before browser readiness.

semanticConclusions.conclusion: Actual full editor patch preserves ordinary two-space/block Tab, ShiftTab unindent, Escape navigation release, Emoji, syntax snippets, both scroll directions, safe insertion, history and IME guards. Existing browser driver ordinary Tab navigation assertion conflicts with restored behavior; finding SPEC-FINAL-001 retained. Physical behavior not executed.
